name: OffAxisCommandSet
description: Off-axis line inaccuracy detection and remediation toolkit for Revit

commands.description: Detect off-axis elements and sketches using Revit's native warning engine
Scan model geometry for lines with angular deviation between minAngleDeg and maxAngleDeg
Detect walls and beams off the 1/4 inch perpendicular regularized grid lattice
Snap endpoints of slightly off-axis walls and structural framing beams to nearest 0/45/90 orientation
Rotate slightly off-axis 3D grid lines about their midpoint to nearest 0/45/90 orientation
Snap normal of slightly off-axis vertical reference planes to nearest 0/45/90 orientation
Fix off-axis sketch profiles of Floors, Ceilings, and FootPrintRoofs using ray-ray corner solver
Fix off-axis sketch lines in In-Place Component Extrusion sketch forms
Fix off-axis top-level model lines and curve chains using ray-ray closure solver
Regularize perpendicular spacing of walls and beams onto a 1/4 inch lattice
